claim: Villagers keep reading Newspapers while they have free time, not just one a day: one was seen reading three in a day. Four villagers in one house, given 12 Newspapers and taken off their jobs, had full Fun within a day or two. Players also switch from Books to Newspapers because they are faster to make and need no Trappers' Hut.

evidence.reference: Player posts on the Outlanders community Discord, 6 November 2026, shared by the maintainer as a screenshot.

notes: Fits the stored values. Three Newspapers is 75 Fun against a fall of 20 a day, so under two days from empty. The Press makes 6 Newspapers from 2 Paper; the Book Workshop needs 2 Paper and an Animal Hide per Book. How many a villager reads in a day is not stored: it depends on free time.
